prompt: Create an original 60 second downtempo electronica instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: analog bass, soft breakbeat, electric piano, pluck synth. Style: steady restrained broken beat with wide atmospheric space. Tempo approximately 84 BPM; D major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A serene and meditative ambient piece featuring gentle piano melodies, soft synth pads, and subtle percussion, creating a peaceful and calming atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静冥想的环境音乐，以柔和的钢琴旋律、轻柔的合成器衬垫和微妙的打击乐器为特色，营造出平和安宁的氛围。
